ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across the primary 2D area of both lobes; high-contrast white geometric clusters are localized at the extreme lateral distal points.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with high-frequency peaks and valleys; serrations are more pronounced and closely spaced on the inner upper edge of the right lobe compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concavity along the trailing edge leading to upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast white pixel clusters located on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy colonization of white encrusting organisms on both distal tips, causing physical alteration of the smooth fluke boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct reddish-purple pixel cluster is visible on the upper-most edge of the right lobe tip, adjacent to the white encrustations.
